run_rl_experiment: run an MRQ reinforcement learning experiment on a Gym environment with default hyperparameters
run_experiment_with_env: run an MRQ RL experiment on a specified environment like Atari or Dmc with custom seed
save_experiment: save an OnlineExperiment checkpoint including agent weights, environment state, and random seeds
load_experiment: load a saved MRQ experiment checkpoint and resume training from the last timestep
evaluate_agent: evaluate an MRQ agent over multiple episodes and log average total reward to a file
